question: How do inference-time patch selection, pruning depth, and retained-token count affect retrieval accuracy and measured inference cost for a frozen CLIP-ReID encoder?

historical_anchor.label: previously reported full Market-1501 results; not a claim that new code reproduces them on another machine

validation.rule: one query image per identity that has at least two cameras; remaining training images are the gallery

selection_rule.candidates: the four cls_attention grid cells, not the random controls
selection_rule.order: highest raw validation mAP, then Rank-1, then lower measured median encoder latency
selection_rule.ceiling_fallback: if every candidate has validation mAP at the ceiling, use block 9 and 96 patches and label the choice predefined

comparisons: cls_attention versus each matched random seed
cls_attention versus the mean of the five random seeds
every compressed setting versus the full encoder
raw cosine is primary; k-reciprocal is secondary and compared only with k-reciprocal
official_test_priority: the additional attention configuration chosen on validation, unless it is the same cell
